title: Posted my game Consume to itch.io free early access
author: ConsumeGameDev
selftext:
[https://consumetheworld.itch.io/consume](https://consumetheworld.itch.io/consume)    
I made this game almost exclusively in claude code, and touched almost none of the code outside of tweaking variables or exporting builds.    
The graphics are all generated from code instructions, and the music was made in sonu.  

Most of the time was spent on iterating the individual assets until I was happy with each, and playtesting each new ability, secret, level, and enemy that I added, which was hundred of hours, I lost track.  

I tried to leave as little decision making to the LLM as possible, and wrote really long briefs explaining what exactly what I wanted in as much detail as possible, then I ran that through the claude skill grill-me to look for anything I didnt think  of.  

If anyone wants to give it a go I'm looking for feedback    
Does the first minute make you want to play more?      
Do the tutorial windows make sense?      
How difficult does it feel?       
Do the secrets feel rewarding?     
Does finding some make you want to look for more?      
Is there anything that feels unfair?     
Any abilities that feel bad to use?     
How does the pacing feel?     
Are the visual and audio elements cohesive?
